answer_1.quote: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated their significant potential in user interactions. A particularly promising area is the development of roleplaying LLM agents, which are capable of simulating both real and fictional roles to deliver immersive and interactive experiences.
answer_1.outputs: role-playing dialogues in bilingual (Chinese-English) settings that align with predefined character profiles across dimensions such as Character, Style, Emotion, Relationship, and Personality

answer_2.quote: We introduce a novel evaluation pipeline that converts all assessment tasks into objective tasks, focusing on the model's ability to follow user-defined role profiles.

answer_3.quote: Combined with "LLMs as Judges", this approach objectively quantifies role-following capabilities with measurable criteria as demonstrated in § B.

answer_4.quote: We conducted instance-level comparisons between model-generated scores and human annotations using cosine similarity, computed at the instance level.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluated the validity of content generated by GPT-4o and assessed alignment between model outputs and expected role profiles across multiple dimensions using predefined criteria.
